title: An edit on a page that gives one font a thousand names, with a large character map, takes less than 3 seconds.
guards: Every name read the font's character map again, so the edit took far too long (v0.3.0).

result.message: Text updated. Verified: nothing else on this page changed.
details: This PDF contained only the letters it used from the font “CMR10”, so PaperKnife added a complete copy of that font from its own fonts for the new text. The rest of the document still uses the PDF's own font.
